name: bucks-browser
description: Bucks Browser — a decentralised, IPFS-native web browser
author: Bucks

scripts.check: npm --prefix ui run check && node scripts/check-main.mjs && npm run lint:design
scripts.dist: npm run build:ui && npm run fetch:kubo && electron-builder
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:ui && npm run fetch:kubo -- --platform linux && electron-builder --linux
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:ui && npm run fetch:kubo -- --platform win32 && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:ui && npm run fetch:kubo -- --platform darwin && electron-builder --mac
